card.name: Punctuation after cardiac conduction abnormalities
card.fires_on: Small punctuation or linking words (comma, parenthesis, 'and', 'or', 'including') that come right after phrases like 'conduction system abnormalities' or 'conduction disturbances'. Also the start of the word 'conduction' itself in heart-rhythm warnings.

modes.label: Punctuation after conduction terms
modes.description: An opening parenthesis, 'e.g.,', 'and', 'or' or 'including' that begins a list of specific rhythm problems after a conduction abnormality phrase.
